verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own fraud controls in a risk-and-fraud-management section: 3D Secure uses a risk score with configurable challenge rules, and merchant, category and merchant-ID blocking protects cardholders. That covers part of the story, but only for 3DS authentication and merchant-level blocking. Missing for 10: fraud scores (network or proprietary) surfaced on authorization requests, suspicious-activity alerts to ops, tooling to block and reissue compromised cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform fights fraud on my issued cards — network fraud scores or its own models surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerts, and tooling to block and reissue compromised cards
